codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly uncomments the saleSyncHook in registry.ts. The hook validates that sales have either a customer or at least one item before allowing sync - empty sales are blocked with reason 'Venta vacía: sin cliente ni productos'. The change is minimal and correct.

summary: The feature implementation is correct. The worker uncommented the saleSyncHook in registry.ts and removed the TODO comment. The hook logic in hooks/sales.ts correctly validates sales before syncing. Typecheck passes for the modified files (errors from PGlite library are pre-existing). The sync hook infrastructure tests pass (12 tests). The 18 test failures are pre-existing issues unrelated to this change (PullService localStorage tests, session storage tests).
